model_scope: Simulated ideal actual-power executor only, not hardware commands or hardware validation
sampled_rule: At each tick, u=clip(z_ref_prime(ghost_work)+(p_ref(ghost_work)-actual_p)/dt,-R,R); actual power exactly ramps with this u until next tick, with hard clamps at 0 and guard cap. Before EOS ghost_work is actual completed work; after true EOS until delayed observation, ghost_work continues potential service. When ghost_work reaches M, command fastest return.
expected_cost: Composite trapezoid over uniform EOS grid, also 513-point agreement; exact per-EOS ramp energy and time
frequency: Exact constant-slope segment propagation, analytic stationary points and all-future zero-input tail; dense EOS maximum is numerical only
ledger: Useful work is W, excess potential service after true EOS is not useful work; all postEOS energy is burn. Cycle duration ends at actual power return; any known-grid zero-input tail is observed but not charged.
pure_delay_bound: Delta J <= 2*(pcap+c)*delay for reference delay alone. Do not apply this as a bound on combined sampling error.
stopping_and_failures: Log any inability to complete work, time exceeding 1000 s, cap or slew excess, unexpected delay-bound failure. Preserve all tested cases; no hardware claims.
